description: Read-side catalog record describing the appointment of a person to a public office. One record per appointment event (re-appointments emit a new record). Cross-references `com.etzhayyim.gov.agency` via `agencyDid`. Constitutional framing per ADR-2605192100 §1.12 + ADR-2605242330: read-side observation, no dependency on the state. The religious-corp may issue separate `com.etzhayyim.member.adherent` SBT records for officials who join as adherents; those are independent and do not derive from this record. Replaces the etzhayyim-side `com.etzhayyim.apps.gov.official` + `vertex_gov_official` table (Kysely → MST, per ADR-2605212100).

agencyDid.description: DID of the agency. Resolves to a `com.etzhayyim.gov.agency` record.

personDid.description: DID of the person appointed, if DID-resolvable. Optional — public officials often lack DIDs; the `personName` / `personNameLocal` fields cover the common case.

personName.description: English-language name of the appointed person. Family-name-last form.

personNameLocal.description: Local-script name of the appointed person.

role.description: Title of the office. Canonical English. Example: 'Minister of Justice', 'Director-General', 'Bureau Chief'.

roleLocal.description: Local-script role title. Example: '法務大臣'.

termEndsAt.description: Term-end date, if known. Omit for indefinite / serving terms.

appointedByDid.description: DID of the appointing authority (agency or office), if applicable.

appointedByRole.description: Role of the appointing authority (e.g. 'Prime Minister', 'President', 'Cabinet').

sourceUri.description: Authoritative source URL (gazette notice, press release, official announcement).
